Profile
Under review. One profile's page. It is reached from Your profiles, from the profile button on a community page, from the Profile tab on a community's own domain, and from any author's name.
Top to bottom: cover, avatar, the profile's label, the community it belongs to, the bio, then one feed of everything the profile has posted, newest first: songs, videos and text together. There are no tabs. Comments are not listed here; they live on the posts. When songs can be bought, a Songs tab is added for that.
The feed is the same component as a community's feed and uses the one post card (Parts/Posts/PostCard) for every kind, per the workspace_owner on 2026-10-12. Every profile screen here, phone and desktop, shows all three kinds: a song post, a video post and a text post.
Dance takes, per the workspace_owner on 2026-10-12: a passed, public dance is an ordinary video post and appears here in the feed like any other, with the ordinary video card and no caption. Tracking a submission is not a profile matter, so the profile has no button, list or status for takes that are waiting or did not pass. A "Your takes" button and page were drawn here the same day and removed.
The label is the handle if there is one, otherwise the name, otherwise "User" and six characters. The community line is always there, because a profile belongs to exactly one community.
Your own profile has Edit. Until it has a handle it also has Get handle, which opens the handle sheet (Flows/Community/JoinAndName). Someone else's profile has no button. More holds Share.
A profile cannot be followed, per the workspace_owner on 2026-10-12. Only communities can.
Edit is one page in the shared task shell: close at the top left, Save in the footer. The cover and avatar are shown as they appear on the profile, each with a camera button; tapping one picks a new image. Below them, name and bio. Nothing is required. The handle is not edited here.
A profile with several handles lists them under the bio.
Desktop: the app sidebar stays, the cover runs the width of the page, and everything else sits in one 640 column. The sidebar's bottom row shows the profile in use and opens the account menu (Parts/Shell/AppShellChrome).
To draw: desktop Edit, several handles, an empty cover on Edit, saving and a failed save, loading, empty, a profile that is gone.
Phone: your profile, your profile with no handle yet, someone else's profile. Each feed shows all three post kinds: song, video (a passed, public dance is one of these) and text
